name: GB KORE ARC 35 sq mm Flexible Pure Copper Welding Cable
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 35 sq mm flexible electrolytic pure copper welding cable with double-sheathed HOFR (Heat, Oil & Flame Retardant) elastomeric rubber insulation.
overview: GB KORE ARC 35 sq mm welding cable is engineered to meet the demanding requirements of manual and automated arc welding rigs, power generators, and high-frequency inverter systems. Fabricated from ultra-fine Class 6 annealed electrolytic copper strands, it offers unparalleled flexibility and high thermal overload tolerance, drastically minimizing voltage drop over long operational runs. The dual-extruded outer jacket is composed of high-grade HOFR (Heat, Oil & Flame Retardant) synthetic rubber, resisting ozone, sparks, diesel fuel, machine oils, and dragging over jagged metal edges.
keyFeatures: 100% Electrolytic grade annealed bare copper conductor (Class 6 multi-strand)
35 sq mm cross-sectional area supporting continuous welding currents up to 400A
HOFR (Heat, Oil, and Flame Retardant) elastomeric rubber protective sheath
Exceptional flexibility allowing tight bends without conductor kink or fatigue
Resistant to hot weld spatter, ozone, mechanical abrasion, and weathering
Conforms to IS 9857 and BS 638 standards for industrial welding power delivery
applications: Connecting power sources to electrode holders and earth clamps
MIG, TIG, and submerged arc welding machines
Heavy fabrication yards, shipyards, and construction sites
Temporary heavy power feed in harsh industrial environments
